title: Backrooms Cycle
description:
Check out this game our friend is making!

Об игреEXPLORE ICONIC LOCATIONSUse the backrooms slide system to explore all the levels. Find the loot you need, or the stuff that the other scientists need. Do not get cocky and try to be ready to face enemies that backrooms throw at you.

HELP OR NOT OTHER SCIENTISTSHelp out other members of the exploration group, or not. You have multiple choices in every questline (some are very questionable). Help upgrade the poolrooms outpost and unlock new levels.

FIGHT LEGENDARY BACKROOMS ENTITIES!Complete the main questline, and fight legendary Backrooms entities. Get better, gear up, visit the trader and get the loot you need. If you try hard enough you may be the one to win your life back from the backrooms.
description_short: Backrooms Cycle is an immersive exploration RPG/FPS horror set in the backrooms. You will explore and scavenge, build up your arsenal and gain powerful perks. Decide if you want to rescue fellow scientists, build an outpost in the poolrooms or just care about yourself.
